blurb: Guests take a 1-hour narrated sunset cruise on the Dixie Belle paddle wheeler, viewing the London Bridge and Lake Havasu shoreline. Cocktails, beer, wine, and soft drinks are available on board. Private charters for up to 131 guests are available with custom packages and a full-service bar.
extraNote: Boat departs promptly at scheduled time · Upper parking lot of the London Bridge Resort; follow pathway down toward the water to the boarding gate. · Year-round
